item.tib: mkha' klong gsang ba'i mdos kyi glud kyi mdel kha
item.coloph: ces mkha' klong gsang ba'i mdos chen gyi glud mdos su btang ba'i mdel kha'o/ lji mang thang po'i don du mdzad pa u ya/ dus ngan lnga brgya'i snyigs ma la/ skye ba (bo) rdol thabs log spyod byed/ lha srin dregs pa'i thus la chug tshe yi 'du byed bar chod byed/ tshe thung nad mang sdug bsngal spyod/ de dus gyer spungs bdag gis kyang / mkha' klong gsang ba'i glud mdos bzhengs/ sems can don du bar chod zhi bar shog lan chags khring (snying) khrin kher nas kyang / bde ba'i 'bras bu thob gyur cig skye bo phal pa'i don du glud mdos su mdzad pa rdzogs snyo/ u ya ag tham sku rgyud lo//
